oracle.statement: for every graded leg (ordinary never-created name expecting the documented 404; overlong 300-char name; spaced name - the latter two graded for body quality only, disposition is the boundary lane's) the error body earns both mandatory rubric points: it names the resource ('collection') or echoes the submitted uuid-marked name segment, AND states the problem (not-found/format hint) - any leg scoring <2 = Type2_PoorDiagnostics; empty/missing error body on a 404 = Type2; a 200 on a never-created name is skipped with a note (_001's Type1 lane); 5xx with /healthz alive = Type3; transport with healthy /healthz = SCRIPT_ERROR; no setup can fail (nothing is created or deleted)
